cards.b: Solana has launched its Alpenglow consensus upgrade on mainnet, replacing the TowerBFT voting system used since 2020. The upgrade targets approximately 150-millisecond finality and a 99% reduction in finality times.

per.SOL: Alpenglow brings faster transaction settlement and aims to improve application responsiveness.

cards.b: Zcash developers have finalized the NU7 mainnet activation height for November 5, targeting a block time reduction from 75 seconds to 25 seconds to triple payment speed.

per.ZEC: Faster block times and tripled payment speeds could drive network utility and trader interest.

cards.t: PancakeSwap Fee Overhaul and CAKE Emissions Vote
cards.b: PancakeSwap is heading to a vote on a proposed fee-sharing overhaul that would allocate 88% of swap fees to liquidity providers while cutting CAKE emissions by 69%.

per.CAKE: The token emission cut and increased fee share aim to support tokenomics as BNB Chain DeFi activity expands.
